# telnyx_oauth_client (Resource)

An OAuth 2.0 client that apps use to get access to the Telnyx API on behalf of users. A confidential client's secret is returned only when it is created and kept in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_oauth_client" "backend" {
  name                = "Backend"
  client_type         = "confidential"
  allowed_grant_types = ["client_credentials"]
  allowed_scopes      = ["admin"]
}

# The secret is returned only when the client is created.
output "backend_client_secret" {
  value     = telnyx_oauth_client.backend.client_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_grant_types` (Set of String) List of allowed OAuth grant types
- `allowed_scopes` (Set of String) List of allowed OAuth scopes
- `client_type` (String) OAuth client type One of `confidential`, `public`.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the OAuth client

### Optional

- `logo_uri` (String) URL of the client logo
- `policy_uri` (String) URL of the client's privacy policy
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) List of allowed redirect URIs
- `require_pkce` (Boolean) Whether PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) is required for this client
- `tos_uri` (String) URL of the client's terms of service

### Read-Only

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret (only included when available, for confidential clients)
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the client was created
- `id` (String) OAuth client identifier
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID that owns this OAuth client
- `record_type` (String) Record type identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the client was last updated
- `user_id` (String) User ID that created this OAuth client

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_oauth_client.example <client_id>
```
